name: Ofnik
summary: Ofniki (Офники) is a Russian and Eastern European youth subculture that developed during the mid-to-late 2010s.
description: Ofniki (Офники) is a Russian and Eastern European youth subculture that developed during the mid-to-late 2010s. It emerged from VK (VKontakte) communities alongside street-level youth culture, combining branded sportswear, group street fighting, and a code of physical dominance, with videos of fights circulated and edited within VK communities.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Physical dominance, group loyaltY, street reputation
